rationale: Owner request 2026-11-16 (second step): US3_PS6_1 (round 046, patch_L 6.32: single minimum 7.988 GHz, edges -8.57 dB at 7.7376 and -9.65 dB at 8.2368, eta_rad 0.571-0.683) with patch_L 6.38 mm (+0.06 mm) to lower the minimum further and balance the edges. Reference US3_PS6 (038, patch_L 6.29): minimum 8.005 GHz, edges -8.16 / -10.40 dB. Measured slope 038 -> 046: about -5.7 MHz per +0.01 mm (17 MHz per 0.03 mm, confounded by a small mesh change). GUIDE_MODEL extrapolation (not an EM result): +0.06 mm -> about -34 MHz, minimum near 7.954 GHz (uncertainty about +-10 MHz). Edge trend 038 -> 046: lower edge improves about 0.14 dB per 0.01 mm, upper edge worsens about 0.25 dB per 0.01 mm; linear extrapolation gives about -9.4 dB at 7.7376 GHz and about -8.15 dB at 8.2368 GHz, so a worst-case S11 <= -10 dB looks implausible (the two edges would cross near patch_L 6.35 at about -8.95 dB). GEOMETRY_ONLY; no S11, efficiency or gain is claimed.
purpose: Lower the single-minimum resonance of US3_PS6_1 by about 34 MHz (patch_L 6.32 -> 6.38 mm, driven patch only) to test whether the worst-edge S11 can reach -10 dB; openEMS base + fine mesh.

US3_PS6_1.note: single design change: driven patch length +0.06 mm. Parasitic (11.0 x 7.05 mm, y -2.91..4.14, z 1.035), U-slot (absolute), transformer 0.80 x 6.60, 50 ohm line width, material, board and port unchanged. All derived metadata recomputed from the polygons (patch edge -3.19; transformer 0.8 x 6.6 from y -9.79; 50 ohm line from y -13); no stale values from US3_PS6.json (see US3_PS6.errata.json) or from US3_PS6_1 were copied.

pre_registered_hypothesis.H0: Single S11 minimum near 7.954 GHz: 8.005 - 0.09 mm x 5.7 MHz/0.01 mm = 7.954 GHz from the measured 038 -> 046 slope (046 itself: 7.988 - 0.06 mm x 5.7 = 7.954). Range 7.940-7.968 GHz (uncertainty about +-10 MHz: slope 5.5-7 MHz per 0.01 mm gives 7.946-7.955 from 046, plus a nonlinearity and mesh-confounding margin). The minimum would lie below f0 = 7.9872 GHz and below the channel centre; no second minimum in the channel. GUIDE_MODEL.
pre_registered_hypothesis.H1: Worst S11 over the whole channel (1 MHz grid, 501 samples) <= -10 dB (owner target; 046: -8.57 / -9.65 dB at the edges). Plausibility from the 038 -> 046 trend (+0.03 mm): lower edge improves about 0.14 dB per 0.01 mm and upper edge worsens about 0.25 dB per 0.01 mm. Linear extrapolation to +0.06 mm: about -9.4 dB at 7.7376 GHz (improves) and about -8.15 dB at 8.2368 GHz (worsens), so the worst edge (about -8.15 dB, upper) is above -10 dB: H1 is NOT plausible by the trend; the edges would cross at about -8.95 dB near patch_L 6.35, so with patch_L alone the trend never reaches -10 dB at both edges. Extrapolation is GUIDE_MODEL (two points, mesh-confounded, possibly nonlinear); expected H1 false. Not claimed.
pre_registered_hypothesis.H2: eta_rad >= 0.55 over the 11 NF2FF points and realized broadside gain >= 2 dBi (046: eta 0.571-0.683; the minimum eta 0.571 is only 0.02 above the threshold, so the lower bound is at risk if the minimum moves 34 MHz; gain 046 not restated here). GUIDE_MODEL expectation: marginal pass for eta, no efficiency valley expected.
pre_registered_hypothesis.decision_rule: H1 true -> design-reviewer (Fable 5.2) and HFSS/PyAEDT scripts (owner decision already given). H1 false -> report the edge values and the trade-off and do NOT continue patch_L without the owner. Minimum outside 7.940-7.968 GHz -> recalibrate the slope with 038/039/046 and this round before any further change.

manufacturability.layers: 3 copper layers (L1 patch + feed + U-slot at z=h, L2 floating parasitic at z=1.035 mm, L3 ground at z=0) and 2 dielectric layers of ~1.035 mm each: a standard 3-copper-layer FR4 multilayer (core + prepreg/core).
manufacturability.vias: none: the parasitic is floating (no probe, no plated through hole in the antenna region); the feed is a planar microstrip.
manufacturability.min_feature_mm: U-slot arms 0.8 mm and gaps unchanged; parasitic is a solid rectangle 11.0 x 7.05 mm; smallest planar gap: 0.28 mm in y between the transformer end and the sheet edge (different layers, z offset 1.035 mm); no copper feature < 0.8 mm.
manufacturability.stackup_note: Dielectric thickness and the exact z of the buried copper depend on the fabricator's core/prepreg library; typical core thicknesses of ~1.0-1.2 mm and prepreg of 0.1-0.2 mm are only an orientation (NOT verified against a datasheet). The model assumes ONE homogeneous eps_r=4.4 over 2.07 mm, so the fabricator must give the real stackup (the prepreg/core eps_r can differ from the core and sets z_par and k).
manufacturability.tolerances_to_specify: layer-to-layer registration and dielectric thickness (+-z_par moves k and f2); etching of patch_L (measured 038 -> 046 slope about 5.7 MHz per 0.01 mm; the intended +0.06 mm change relative to 046 corresponds to about 34 MHz). Same rough FR4 + copper-roughness caveat as the rest of the campaign.
manufacturability.risks: z_par and registration are not controlled by the TFG; homogeneous provisional FR4 model; a floating inner sheet cannot be inspected or tuned after lamination. The change (+0.06 mm relative to US3_PS6_1) is of the order of etching tolerance (about 5.7 MHz per 0.01 mm: an error of +-0.02 mm is about +-11 MHz) and the 0.28 mm y offset of the sheet edge from the patch edge is of the order of the layer registration tolerance. The expected trade-off puts the upper channel edge at risk.
